reasoning: 驗證目標：在 ON AIR 類別選取某場比賽或頻道時，調諧至對應頻道。為什麼這樣切：可觀察後果是調諧結果，前置條件令所選比賽的頻道非現行頻道，否則無變化亦通過；並對清單第二列而非首列操作，排除「一律調到第一列」的實作。與 113 的差別：該 leaf 驗清單內容，本 leaf 驗選取後的調諧（§8.2.1）。

tcs.tc_title: Selecting a game on ON AIR tunes to its channel
tcs.test_item: The HU shall tune to the corresponding channel when a game or channel is selected on the ON AIR category
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. At least two favorite teams' games are on air on channels other than the currently tuned channel
5. The Game Zone ON AIR list is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the currently tuned channel
2. Select the second game in the ON AIR list
3. Read the tuned channel
tcs.expected_result:
1. The tuned channel is not a channel carrying one of the listed games
2. The selection is accepted
3. The tuned channel is the channel shown for the selected game
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
